Postmark-Email-Blast.Description: The Postmark Email Blast is a Visual Basic (VB)-based email broadcasting system that uses MySQL as its database and Postmark as the email delivery service. The system is designed for high-volume email campaigns using parallel processing while maintaining a configurable and controlled email sending rate.

PDF-Name-Filter.Description: PDF Name Filter is a simple yet effective tool designed to help you filter and organize PDF files from a large collection based on a list of filenames provided in a text file. It efficiently scans through a pile of PDF files, compares each file's name to the entries in your provided list, and moves the matching PDFs into a designated folder. This tool is perfect for organizing large repositories of PDF files quickly and with minimal effort.

PDF-Print-Align.Description: This program is designed to modify the page orientation of PDF files to ensure compatibility with older industrial printers that may have limitations in handling certain page formats. It provides a simple and efficient solution for users needing to print documents with specific orientation adjustments.
